title: City Adviser Case Study Series: Addis-Ababa BRT System- Stakeholder engagement series
summary: This C40 case study describes “City Adviser Case Study Series: Addis-Ababa BRT System- Stakeholder engagement series,” an urban initiative documented for Addis Ababa. It is included because it addresses air pollution pm25 hazards, and it has evidence relevant to children's livelihoods, and it is located in the Global South.
